resale_co.name: Certificate of Habitability (COH)
requirements: Written application to the Zoning Officer with owner names and addresses, a description of the dwelling and any managing agent
Fee paid in full when the application is filed

Inspection finding the dwelling safe and fit for human habitation and in line with state statutes and Borough housing and health ordinances; violations must be corrected before the certificate is issued
Combined form also covers the residential fire inspection: number of smoke detectors, CO detectors and fire extinguishers (form still lists extinguishers)

fees.label: Certificate of Habitability and Residential Fire Inspection, more than 10 days ahead (combined application)
Certificate of habitability inspection, each dwelling unit (Code Section 127-4B)
fees.quote: The fee for each inspection of a dwelling unit shall be $35.

fees.label: Certificate of habitability reinspection (Code)
fees.quote: The fee for a reinspection of a dwelling unit, if required, shall be $20.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the 'Certificate of Habitability and Residential Fire Inspection Application' from the Borough Forms page (a COH Pre-Checklist is also posted), mark it Resale, give the closing date and inspection contact, and file it with the fee at Borough Hall, 23 Maple Avenue, Netcong, NJ 07857 (973-347-0252). Contact the Zoning Department for the application.
resale_co.contact_title: Zoning Officer (enforcement officer for certificates of habitability)

evidence.quote: No person, firm or corporation shall sell a dwelling or dwelling unit or permit the same to be sold without first obtaining a certificate of habitability, nor shall any person, firm or corporation buying a dwelling or dwelling unit and intending to occupy the same, do so, without securing a certificate of habitability, as hereinafter provided.
The Zoning Officer of the Borough of Netcong is hereby designated as the enforcement officer to exercise the powers prescribed by this chapter.
All fees paid for the issuance of a certificate of habitability shall be nonrefundable.
You are required to obtain a Certificate of Habitability when you are selling your home.
No person, firm or corporation shall sell a dwelling or dwelling unit or permit the same to be sold without first obtaining a certificate of habitability (COH)
Certificate of Habitability and Residential Fire Inspection Application

resale_co.notes: Chapter 127 of the Borough Code (read through the ecode360 print view) requires a certificate of habitability for every sale and sets $35 per inspection and $20 per reinspection. The Borough's current form combines the COH with the residential smoke/CO fire inspection; its fees ($100 / $160 / $185) equal the $35 COH fee plus the fire fees in Code Section 157-8 ($65 / $125 / $150), though the form does not say so. No named zoning officer or email was found on the Borough site; for rental inspections the site gives 973-347-0252 x 106. Building permits are handled by Byram Township's construction office (shared service, 973-347-2500 x 123). Annual rental registration and inspections are rental items, not sale items.

requirements: Smoke alarms located and maintained per N.J.A.C. 5:70-4.19 and NFPA 72
Carbon monoxide alarms per N.J.A.C. 5:70-4.19 and NFPA 720
Portable fire extinguisher per N.J.A.C. 5:70-4.19(e) (Borough code and form still list it)
Installed fire alarm systems may need testing and maintenance records before the certificate is issued

authorities.name: Netcong Borough Bureau of Fire Prevention
authorities.lead_time: Fee depends on how long before the change of ownership the inspection is requested: at least 10 days for the lowest fee.

fees.label: Smoke alarm, CO alarm and extinguisher certificate (CSACMAPFEC), requested at least 10 days before the change of ownership (Code Section 157-8)
fees.quote: A fee of $65 shall be paid by the owner prior to each inspection, provided the inspection is requested at least 10 days prior to the change of occupancy or ownership.

fees.label: Requested within 10 days (Code)
fees.quote: If the inspection is requested within 10 days of the change of occupancy or ownership, a fee of $125 shall be paid.

fees.label: Requested within 4 days (Code)
fees.quote: If the inspection is requested within four days of the change of occupancy or ownership, a fee of $150 shall be paid.

fees.label: Certificate of Habitability and Residential Fire Inspection, more than 10 days ahead (combined application)

authorities.how_to_apply: Use the combined Certificate of Habitability and Residential Fire Inspection Application (Borough Forms page). For questions email the Fire Prevention Bureau at netcongfpb@netcong.org or call (862) 599-0155; hours vary, so ask for an appointment.

evidence.quote: The Fire Official of the Bureau of Fire Prevention and duly appointed inspectors are hereby empowered to conduct the necessary inspections and to issue certificates of compliance as contemplated herein.

Violation of §157-8, Certificate of smoke alarm, carbon monoxide alarm, and portable fire extinguisher compliance. Any person violating any of the provisions of this section shall, for each offense, be subject to a fine of not less than $500.
Feel free to email the bureau for an appointment at netcongfpb@netcong.org . You can also contact the bureau at (862) 599-0155.
1428 Netcong Borough LEAID: 1428-001 Netcong Boro Enf Auth. Fire Dept Fire Official Mark J Sylvester Phone (973) 347-0252 Email netcongfpb@gmail.com

fire_cert.notes: Code Section 157-8 (added March 14, 2024 by Ord. 2024-4) sets the fire certificate fees. The combined Borough form's fees appear to be the COH fee plus these fire fees. The state fire directory (survey 4/7/2025) lists netcongfpb@gmail.com and (973) 347-0252 and, oddly, 'Twp of Roxbury Zoning Officer' as the smoke detector compliance name; the Borough's own page gives netcongfpb@netcong.org and (862) 599-0155, which are used here. The code and form still include a portable fire extinguisher, which state law (P.L.2025, c.19) removed from the sale certificate in February 2025.
